protocol: Three consecutive make bench runs under mise exec (Node 24.22.1, Bun 1.4.3); each run is the unmodified output/bench.json. Documentation tables use the median of the three per-run medians.

runs.protocol: Two complete warmup rounds, 7 measured rounds; isolated child per version/runtime/mode. Same values, randomized lookups, atomic batches, fsync barriers, assertions, compaction and reopen. Runtime order reverses version order. No timing assertion in correctness gates.
runs.units: milliseconds per workload; 1000 reads, scan rows or atomic batch mutations
runs.limitations: One darwin arm64 host and warm filesystem cache. Not cold-device latency, power-loss certification, or a universal speed ranking. sync mode blocks its calling thread.
